About the Thursday Night Ride group ride

Portland's longest-running weekly social ride. Routes and leaders change each week; expect a party-paced loop with the regulars of the so-called rolling dive bar. Listed every week on the Shift calendar.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
